'''Modifiers''' ---- '''Modifiers''' are special attributes applied to matches that can affect gameplay. Some of them make the match harder, while others are purely cosmetic. Selected '''Modifiers''' appear on the bottom left side of the screen during the match. While most modifiers are automatically chosen at the start of the match based on the mode or map, a few select modifiers obtained from [[Challenge Trials]] can be voted for in modes that support toggleable modifiers.
